q1: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS C WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS) ORDER BY 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS C WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS) ORDER BY 1
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are designed to select the names of customers who have not placed any orders. The only difference is that Q2 includes an ORDER BY clause, which does not affect the result set as the ORDER BY does not change the output of the SELECT statement.
